segments.label: Paso 1 - correr el script de autorizacion
segments.texto_narrado: Let's *connect* TikTok. Our script builds the official *authorization URL*// with exactly the scopes our app needs.

segments.label: Paso 2 - abrir el link, iniciar sesion, copiar el codigo
segments.texto_narrado: The user opens that link,// signs in with their own TikTok account,// and *TikTok* itself shows the permissions being requested before anything is copied.

segments.label: Paso 3 - pegar el codigo, obtener access token
segments.texto_narrado: Once they allow access,// TikTok hands back a short-lived *authorization code*. We paste it into our script,// which exchanges it directly with TikTok's servers for an *access token* and a *refresh token*// -- no password ever touches our app, only these two scoped tokens.

segments.label: Paso 4 - cargar el token, correr el publicador
segments.texto_narrado: With that *access token* loaded,// we run our publishing script against the real *Content Posting API*: it checks the creator's posting settings,// uploads the video file directly,// and waits for *TikTok* to confirm the post is complete.

segments.label: Paso 5 - verificacion visual en el perfil de TikTok
segments.texto_narrado: And *there* it is: a real video,// published straight to the account's profile on *TikTok*// -- from authorization, to token, to a live *post*, entirely through our app.
